people.imagined: Remembered: the hunter who sold herbs, on the coast road in 520, kneeling to set the first locust sapling into the earth, a basket of saplings beside him, sun through the first leaves.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait of the clan founder at forty-five, kneeling on a dusty coast road pressing earth round a young locust sapling with both hands. Face: a lean, brown, patient face with deep sun lines; soft dark eyes lowered on the sapling; thick straight brows; a hooked nose; a gentle half-smile; a short black-and-grey beard. Hair: black with grey, tied up in a knot under a plain straw hat tipped back. Body: tall, lean and long-armed, kneeling on one knee with his shoulders bowed over the work, the patient stillness of a hunter in his back. Clothing: a hunter's coat of fine brown-green cloth, clean and well cut, sleeves rolled to the elbow, with a leather belt and a pouch of dried herbs; leather leggings; no ornament. Hands and objects: both hands settle soil round a slender sapling with four small bright leaves, the nails dark with earth; beside him a woven basket crowded with more saplings, their roots wrapped in damp cloth. Background: a pale dusty coast road running away toward blue mountains, a few old stumps standing either side where trees were cut, one crow on a stump, and a wide hazy sky. Light: warm morning light from the upper left, a pale yellow glow on the sapling's leaves. Expression: a gentle, absorbed half-smile, the eyes lowered and soft, the face of a man planting for people he will never meet. The whole picture faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. A faint soft green and pale-yellow tint.

people.imagined: Mid-summer on the locust road. He walks slowly under the blossom with a pruning hook, stops at a tree, and says the name of the child who planted it. Yellow pollen is in his beard and he is smiling to the tree, not to anyone.
people.subject: The moment: standing under a flowering locust tree on a road in summer, one hand laid on its trunk, greeting it by name with a quiet smile. Face: a broad, deeply tanned old face, wide cheekbones, many lines; small kind dark eyes with a hidden watchfulness; heavy grey brows; a broad nose; a wide mouth in a soft smile; a thick white beard in which a dusting of pale-yellow locust pollen shows plainly, the first thing seen. Hair: white, thick, tied up in a hunter's knot with a leather thong. Body: broad, heavy-shouldered, with a hunter's stoop. Clothing: a long robe dyed warm locust-flower yellow in a fine soft cloth, clean and well cut, with a crossed collar and wide sleeves, a dark brown belt; on his left breast a small green jade bead on a knotted rope. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a long pruning hook, its blade bright; the left rests flat on a tree trunk. Background: a long road tunnel of locust trees heavy with white blossom, dappled green shade, a distant range. Light: dappled gold-green light from the upper left. Expression: patient, content, a stubborn waiting under it. A faint cool blue-green tint of water and wood.

people.imagined: Dawn at the foot of the road at the inn, in the doorway. He stands with a basket of dumplings under a cloth beside his ledger, a locust twig behind his ear, handing it to a guide with a stiff little lie about who it is for.
people.subject: The moment: in an inn doorway at dawn, handing a covered basket to a guide, a ledger tucked under his other arm. Face: a quiet, plain, gentle face; light brown skin; tired kind brown eyes; thin straight brows; a straight nose; a closed mouth that almost smiles; neat clean-shaven cheeks. Hair: black with a little grey, combed flat and tied in a small knot, a green locust twig tucked behind the right ear. Body: medium, slightly round-shouldered, soft-spoken in every line. His posture is a little forward, the habit of a man who bows to guests all day, with his elbows close to his ribs and his feet together on the threshold. Clothing: a plain, fine robe of dark brown cloth with a crossed collar and neat sleeves, a clean white apron over it; a small cap-less head. Under the apron the robe's sleeves are cuffed with a narrow band of locust-yellow thread, the only colour on him. Hands and objects: the right hand extends a round bamboo basket covered with a white cloth; the left arm clamps a thick bound ledger with blank grey covers against his side. Background: the stone doorway of a road inn with a lantern, saddled horses, a pale dawn. Beyond the door a long wooden counter with rows of cups, a hanging lamp burnt down to a stub, and, far down the road, the first of the locust trees as dark upright shapes in the mist; a guide in a grey cloak waits just inside the frame. Light: soft pale dawn from the upper left. Expression: a careful, tender, slightly stiff look, the mouth closed on something unsaid and the tired eyes kind and watchful, hiding more than he shows. A faint moisture-blue cool tint.

people.imagined: Winter evening by a lamp. She is turning a thimble on its ribbon while listening to a visitor, a half-sewn fur cape across her knees, flour still white in the seams of her sleeves.
people.subject: The moment: seated by a lamp with a half-sewn fur cape across her knees, turning a thimble on a ribbon between her fingers while she listens. Face: a soft, round, kindly old face, deeply lined; pale brown skin; warm tired brown eyes; thin white brows; a small nose; a gentle closed mouth. Hair: thin white hair in a neat low bun with a bone pin. Body: small, plump and bent. Clothing: a clean dark-green quilted jacket of good cloth over a pale blouse; the cuffs of both sleeves have white flour caught in every seam, plainly visible; an apron. The quilted jacket has dark thread knots at the front fastenings, and the thimble ribbon is faded red. Hands and objects: the right hand turns a brass thimble hung on a red ribbon at her neck; the left holds a thick grey-brown fur cape with a half-finished hem and a needle. Her hands are small and swollen at the knuckles, the left forefinger pricked with a tiny red dot from the needle; a ball of grey thread rolls at her feet. Background: Behind her, a narrow bed with a patchwork quilt, a clay stove with a kettle just starting to steam, and a window whose shutter shows a thin line of snow outside; a pair of small boots, much mended, stand ready by the door. Light: warm amber lamp light from the lower left. Expression: a patient, attentive, loving look, the head tilted a little to listen and the soft old mouth ready to smile. A faint warm wood tint.

people.imagined: A loud afternoon at the dye works. He is about to bet on anything, a pair of dice in one yellow hand, laughing at a guest who owes him, arms yellow to the wrists.
people.subject: The moment: shaking a pair of dice in his cupped right hand, mid-laugh, ready to throw. Face: a broad, loud, red face; shiny cheeks; bright, quick, merry eyes with a shrewd glint; thick black brows; a big nose; a huge laughing mouth; a neat black moustache. Hair: black, in a loose knot, with a yellow-stained cord. Body: stocky, barrel-chested, restless. Clothing: a short coat of fine locust-yellow cloth, sleeves rolled to the elbow; a black leather belt with brass studs; a clean white shirt; both forearms and both hands dyed deep yellow to the wrist as if in gloves, the main thing. The yellow coat has big horn buttons and a collar edged in black braid; the sleeves are pushed up in a thick roll showing the hairy forearms dyed to the elbow in a deep egg-yolk yellow with a few paler streaks where the dye has worn. A purse of dice-money swings at his belt, drawn in red leather. Hands and objects: the right hand holds two dice up near his ear; the left hand rests on a copper vat rim, yellow-stained. Background: Beyond him a stack of folded yellow cloth, a wet wooden drying rack hung with long strips of dyed silk in several shades from lemon to amber, and a loose crowd of blurred dyers stirring vats; a plain wooden dice cup lies on an upturned barrel. Light: bright warm light from the upper left, everything yellow-washed. Expression: a boisterous, red-faced laugh with the eyes screwed up and shrewd, a man enjoying the throw and already planning the next trick. A faint cool blue-silver tint in the shadows.

people.imagined: At a broken fence in the valley fields. He sniffs the air before speaking, then answers a question that was asked a beat ago, as if the words had to walk to him from far away.
people.subject: The moment: leaning on a broken fence, sniffing the air with his head lifted, a slow dawning look. Face: a broad, sun-reddened, mild farmer's face; vague soft eyes with drooping lids; thick sandy-grey brows; a broad nose lifted in the sniff; a slightly open mouth; a few days of stubble. Hair: thin grey-brown, under a wide straw hat tipped back. Body: big, soft and slow, shoulders drooping. Clothing: a good plain brown farmer's jacket of fine cloth, clean enough but loose; a rope belt; rolled trousers. the right elbow carries one clumsy stitched seam in mismatched grey thread, a fault he has not noticed; a loose strip of sacking is tied round his waist as an apron, and one trouser leg is pulled down over a muddy boot while the other is hitched up. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a fence post that is leaning; the left rests on a hoe. His hands are large, cracked and slow, one thumb bound in a strip of clean linen. Background: In the field beyond the fence, three brown cattle have strayed across a half-planted row, a small boy runs after them in the blur, and the far hills are a soft blue under a high summer sky; a hoe and a bucket lie where he left them in the grass. Light: warm bright light from the upper left. Expression: a slow, dawning, half-puzzled look, the lids drooping and the mouth a little open, the face of a man who has smelled something and not yet worked out what. A faint cool green tint.

people.imagined: On the landing, watching a gull. He rolls on his feet like a deck, a laugh waiting at the lifted corner of his lip, deciding whether to sail by what the bird does.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a landing stage watching a gull, rocking on his heels like a deck, the scar at his lip lifting it to a permanent smirk. Face: a ruddy, weathered, craggy face; a white fish-hook scar at the left corner of the mouth that pulls it up so that he always looks about to laugh, big and plain; bright blue-grey eyes squinting skyward; sun-bleached thick brows; a crooked nose; salt-white stubble. Hair: grey, cropped, under a faded blue knit cap. Body: barrel-chested, short-legged, broad. He stands with his legs a little too wide and bent, as if on a rolling deck, his shoulders swaying; the scarred lip lifts the whole left cheek into a fold. Clothing: a short sea-blue coat of fine oiled cloth, clean, with horn buttons; a knotted yellow neck-cloth; wide canvas trousers; sea boots. A short fishing knife in a wooden sheath is stuck in his belt, and his hands are big, red and knotted from rope. Hands and objects: the right hand shades his eyes; the left holds a coil of rope. Background: The landing stage has two small black boats with furled brown sails tied beside it, nets drying on poles, a single white gull on a post with its head cocked toward him, and a bank of low sea mist with a faint sun behind it. Light: bright cold sea light from the upper left. Expression: an amused, lopsided look, the scarred lip dragging the whole left cheek into a fold so that he seems always about to laugh at some private joke. A faint cool blue sea tint.

people.imagined: At the vats. Someone has told her what she must do. Her chin has come up before she says no, a yellow-dyed fringe falling over her eye and being tucked back behind an ear with a yellow hand.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a dye vat, her chin lifted, tucking a yellow-dyed lock of hair behind her ear with a yellow-stained hand. Face: a young, strong-boned, handsome face; clear brown skin; flashing dark eyes; straight firm brows; a straight nose; a mouth set to say no; a dimple. A loose strand of the yellow fringe has stuck to her damp cheek. Hair: black, with a thick fringe dyed bright locust-yellow at the front, which she tucks behind the ear, plainly visible. Body: strong, straight, shoulders squared. Clothing: a fine green work jacket of good cloth with the sleeves rolled to the elbow, and a clean grey apron; a yellow cord belt; both hands and forearms stained deep yellow. The green jacket is fitted with horn toggles and has dark splashes of yellow dye across its front like paint; an apron of heavy grey canvas with a deep pocket hangs from her neck; her sleeves are pushed to the elbow and the yellow stain on her arms ends in a sharp line at each elbow. Hands and objects: the right hand at the ear is yellow; the left grips a long wooden dye paddle. Background: Behind her: a row of three copper vats with steam curling up, yellow and amber cloth hung in long banners above them against a pale sky, a wooden ladder, and a blurred older man, her father, turning with a frown at the edge of the frame. Light: bright morning light from the upper left. Expression: a defiant look, chin lifted, the flashing eyes level and the mouth set to say no, a dimple showing despite herself. A faint cool water-blue shimmer.

people.imagined: Rehearsing, alone by the field wall: a question he has been told to ask. His voice breaks on the third word and he clears his throat like a man announcing himself.
people.subject: The moment: standing straight in a field, chest out, clearing his throat after his voice has cracked, a blush rising. Face: a thin, eager, spotty young face; large earnest dark eyes; thin straight brows; a straight nose; a big Adam's apple, a mouth just closing; a little fuzz on the upper lip. Hair: black, uncombed, a cowlick. Body: tall and thin, all wrists and knees, hands too big. Clothing: a clean, new, fine dark-grey jacket slightly short in the sleeves, so that the wrists stick out; a rope belt; a wooden practice sword at the hip. The dark-grey jacket is clearly new, its creases from the shop still sharp, with a plain brown rope belt knotted too tight; the sleeves end above the wrist bones. A small wooden practice sword with a bound grip is carried at his hip, tapping his leg. Hands and objects: both fists clenched in front, thin wrists bare. His knuckles are white where his fists clench, and his throat bobs. Background: Behind him a drystone field wall, young green barley in rows to the horizon, a distant mountain with a grey crown of cloud where a gate waits, and two crows on a fencepost watching him; a wild rose bush at the corner of the wall is just in bud. Light: bright morning light from the upper left. Expression: an earnest, flustered look, the throat bobbing and a blush climbing the cheeks, the eyes fixed bravely ahead. A faint cool metal glint on the wooden sword.

people.imagined: Remembered: the bridge-builder in the flood, standing waist-deep in brown water with both arms round a stone pillar, his face lifted against the current, holding.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait of the bridge builder at fifty-five, waist-deep in a flood with both arms wrapped round a great stone pillar, his face lifted and set against the current. Face: a heavy, square, mason's face; skin tanned and grey with stone dust; thick, strong brows; narrow eyes fixed on something above the water; a wide nose; a clenched jaw; a short grey beard dripping. Hair: grey, wet, plastered. Body: massive, thick-necked and very broad, braced chest-deep against the current with his head thrown back so that the tendons of the neck stand taut. Clothing: a short coat of heavy brown cloth soaked dark, the sleeves shoved above the elbow to show a thick scarred forearm with veins standing like ropes; a mason's leather apron; a stone mason's chisel still hooked at his belt, dripping. Hands and objects: both arms embrace the pillar, the hands locked on each other; dark water swirls to his chest with floating branches, and it pushes a pale V of foam against him. Background: Above him the pale stone underside of a great arch, a curtain of rain, and, on the far side, small dark figures on the bridge pointing; the water is a heavy pale brown and carries a drowned cart wheel and snapped branches, all drawn without any splash of white except at his chest. Light: pale grey light from the upper left. Expression: a locked jaw and narrowed eyes fixed upward, a face set hard as the stone he holds. The whole picture faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. A faint earth-brown tint.

people.imagined: On the bridge at dusk. A cart creaks past and his eyes go to its axles before the driver's face; he stands heavy and slow in a coat the colour of dried clay, the seal of the bridge cord hanging at his chest.
people.subject: The moment: standing at the end of a stone bridge, looking down at the axles of a passing cart instead of the driver. Face: a heavy, square, slow face; skin ruddy brown; thick grey brows; small shrewd eyes lowered; a big flat nose; a wide, patient mouth turned down; a thick grey moustache; heavy jowls. Hair: grey and cropped, thinning. Body: heavy, square and slow, massive shoulders and thick forearms. Clothing: a stiff, long coat of river-silt felt, grey-brown and hard as baked clay, closed at the neck, worn smooth and clean but unchanging; a broad leather belt; a plain white shirt. The stiff silt-felt coat has a high round collar and big flat horn buttons, a pale line of dried mud along the hem; the seal on its cord rests on the slope of his chest. His square grey fingernails are cut short, and a heavy iron ring sits on the left thumb. A leather satchel of token cords hangs at his hip. Hands and objects: huge mason's hands rest on the stone parapet; around his neck on a cord hangs a small round grey stone seal, its face smooth, unwritten. Background: Behind him: the long grey arches of a paired stone bridge over a wide brown river, a line of heavy ore carts with dark grey rock in their beds, carters in blurred conical hats, and a small stone toll house with a red lantern at the bridge's end. Light: low warm light from the upper left. Expression: a calm, heavy, calculating look, the small eyes lowered on the axles and the wide mouth turned down, as immovable as the parapet under his hands. A faint earth-yellow tint.

people.imagined: In the north toll house, copying figures into a book with ink on her sleeve, toll tokens on a cord at her wrist clicking. She has just crossed out a number, quietly.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a desk, a brush lifted over a book, a line crossed out. Face: a neat, narrow, pale-brown face; steady grey-brown eyes; thin, straight grey brows; a fine straight nose; a calm mouth; fine lines. Hair: grey, smooth, drawn into a tight low bun with a plain wooden pin. Body: slender, upright, composed. Clothing: a neat grey robe of good cloth with a crossed collar and long sleeves; the right sleeve cuff has a dark smear of ink; at her left wrist a cord strung with a dozen small round bronze tokens, each with a square hole, no marks. Her grey robe has a modest narrow belt of dark cloth, the sleeve ends fastened with small bone buttons; a thin second cord at her right wrist carries a tiny brass key; the ink on the cuff is a big black blot. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a brush; the left rests on an open ledger. Her fingers are long and neat; a faint line of ink follows the knuckle of the right forefinger. Background: On the wall behind her a rack of thick unmarked ledgers with coloured cord spines, a window showing grey river light and the corner of a bridge parapet, a small teapot on a brazier, and on the desk a little dish with a handful of waived toll tokens set apart from the rest. Light: soft window light from the upper left. Expression: a quiet, careful look, the mouth composed and the grey eyes steady, with a flicker of private kindness she is hiding behind the ledger. A faint earth tint.

people.imagined: Early morning at the bridge head, counting a cart's axles under his breath, an oilcloth coat dripping, eyes already on the next one.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a bridge head in drizzle, lips moving as he counts axles, finger lifting for each. Face: a long, lean, hard face; skin weathered and sallow; thick dark brows drawn together; sharp restless eyes; a long straight nose; a thin mouth moving silently; a clean-shaven chin with a razor nick. Hair: black, combed back wet, with a tiny topknot. Body: tall, thin and narrow-shouldered, hunched against the damp with his chin tucked in, one foot a little ahead as if ready to step into the road in front of a cart; dark boots splashed to the knee, a drop of water hanging from the tip of his nose. Clothing: a long toll-keeper's oilcloth coat, glossy dark yellow-green, fine and clean, buttoned to the neck; leather gloves; under it a good grey robe with narrow sleeves, a belt of woven black cord and a small bronze scale-pan charm. Hands and objects: the right forefinger lifts and ticks off axles in the air; the left hand holds a small bound toll-book with blank covers. Background: A line of three laden carts stands in the rain with their drivers hunched, a heavy grey sky, a muddy track and wet stone bridge rails shining; a second man in a darker coat with a brass-bound case, the assayer, stands blurred beyond the carts. Light: flat grey light from the upper left. Expression: a tight, hungry look, the thin mouth working through a sum and the sharp eyes jumping from axle to axle with no patience for the driver's talk. A faint cool grey-green tint.

people.imagined: Coming up from a spring dive under the north bridge, river mud on his hair, grinning at the water with a cracked canine showing, his hand still cold from the crack.
people.subject: The moment: climbing out of a river after a dive, grinning back at the water, a cracked canine tooth showing. Face: a tanned, wet, cheerful square face; mud streaked on the cheek; easy brown eyes; thick brows; a broad nose; a wide grin with the left canine cracked in half, plain and visible. Hair: black, wet and plastered flat with silt. Body: strong, wide-shouldered, thick-armed, broad-chested. Clothing: a wet short jacket of dark-brown cloth, fine and clean apart from the mud, clinging to the shoulders and split a finger's width along one shoulder seam where he hauled himself up, showing a pink scrape; wet linen trousers; a rope belt with a lump of green river weed clinging to it; bare feet grey with silt to the ankle. Hands and objects: the right hand, bright with cold, is held half-open as though it has just touched stone; the left holds a rope whose thin braid trails into the water; water streams from his hair and fingertips. Background: Behind him the dark stone base of the bridge pier rises out of green water, a ladder of iron rungs, a hint of a long vertical crack in the stone just visible at the waterline, and a small girl's head, his daughter, peering over the parapet far above. Light: bright light from the upper left, water glints. Expression: an easy, careless grin over one shoulder, the cracked tooth showing and the eyes bright with cold water, a man pleased with the dive. A faint river-blue tint.

people.imagined: On a barge deck checking a hawser, strong hands running along it, laughing a sharp laugh like a rope snapping at a joke, forearms scarred with parallel lines.
people.subject: The moment: running a thick hemp rope through her hands on a barge, laughing suddenly. Face: a lean, strong, brown face with bright dark eyes and crow's-feet; straight brows; a short nose; a wide mouth open in a sharp laugh. Hair: dark brown with grey, braided and wound in a tight crown. Her hair has a streak of grey at the front and a few loose curls stuck to her cheek with sweat. Body: wiry, strong-shouldered. She stands with feet apart on the wet deck, back straight, shoulders broad from hauling; her laugh throws her head back and her throat shows the corded muscle. Clothing: a good dark-blue jacket of fine cloth with sleeves rolled to the elbow, an apron; a rope belt. The apron is heavy grey canvas with a rope-fibre fringe, the belt a loop of tarred cord with a marlinspike on it. Hands and objects: both forearms bear neat parallel pale scars from hemp burns, big and plain; her hands grip a thick rope. Background: Around her: coils of grey-gold hemp hawser as thick as a thigh, tied-up barges rocking on brown water, a rack of fresh twisted rope drying, and in the haze behind the long twin arches of the bridges; a heron stands on a bollard. Light: bright light from the upper left. Expression: a sudden, sharp, merry laugh, the head thrown back and the crow's-feet deep, bright eyes on the water. A faint warm hemp-brown tint.

people.imagined: Poling a ferry in high water, stooped like the pole she carries, shouting a price across the flood to a family on the far bank, in no hurry.
people.subject: The moment: standing at the back of a flat ferry, stooped over a long pole, shouting a price across brown water. Face: a sharp, hard, tanned face; narrow bright eyes; thin hard brows; a small sharp nose; a wide mouth open mid-shout. Hair: black, in a tight tail, a scarf on the forehead. Body: tall, stooped like the pole she holds, long arms nearly straight on it and her back bent like a bow; bare feet gripping the wet planks, a fine mist of spray hanging round her. Clothing: a short dark-blue jacket of fine oiled cloth, glossy with a stiff collar and spattered with muddy water; a broad leather belt with three small brass buckles; rolled trousers. Hands and objects: both hands wrap a long wooden pole; a fat small bag of coins swings at her belt. Background: Across the water a far muddy bank with a huddle of three small figures, a mother with a bundle, a girl and a small boy sitting on a trunk, wrapped in a blanket; a half-submerged fence post, drifting reeds, and a low grey sky with a sliver of yellow at the horizon. Light: flat grey light from the upper left. Expression: a hard, impatient stare and a mouth thrown open mid-shout, with nothing in the face for the huddle on the far bank but the price. A faint cool grey tint.

people.imagined: At his clerk's desk, counting a cart's tolls on his fingers while a driver talks, an ink smear on the tip of his pinched nose, watching a hand and not a face.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a clerk's table, counting on his fingers while someone talks to him out of frame. Face: a thin, pinched, pale face; narrow darting eyes; thin dark brows pulled in; a pinched nose with a black ink smear on the tip, plainly visible; a thin tight mouth. Hair: black, thin, oiled flat, a tiny knot. Body: thin, narrow-shouldered, hunched over the table. Clothing: a neat grey-brown clerk's robe of fine cloth with sleeve protectors of black cloth, a sash. The grey-brown robe has a high collar and the black sleeve protectors reach to the elbow, tied with thread; at his belt hangs a small abacus no longer than a hand. Hands and objects: the right hand counts on the left fingers; a brush behind the ear; a ledger with blank columns open before him. His fingers are thin, nervous and ink-stained; the left forefinger is raised mid-count with the thumb folded under, and the brush behind his ear has a split tip. Background: Through the toll window beside him a blurred cart and driver, a tray of copper coins sorted into three heaps, a hanging brass scale, a stack of tally sticks, a second book hidden half under the first, and a draught from the window stirring the paper. Light: dull light from the upper left. Expression: a suspicious, pinched look, the narrow eyes darting to the side and the thin mouth tight, counting the speaker's motives along with the coins. A faint earth-brown tint.

people.imagined: On the toll-house roof, tilting her head in quick jerks like a bird to count the carts below, freckles at the corners of her eyes, finger tapping the tally.
people.subject: The moment: crouched on a roof edge, head turned sharply sideways like a bird, counting carts below. Face: a small, bright, freckled face; freckles at the outer corner of each eye; quick dark eyes; thin brows; a small nose; a mouth open a little as she counts. Hair: brown, in two short braids tied with green cord. Body: small, light, balanced on the balls of her feet. Clothing: a neat green-brown jacket of fine cloth with a small bird embroidered at the hem in plain brown thread; trousers tucked into soft new boots; a sash with a tally of cut sticks tied to it, and a sprig of green pinned at her collar. Hands and objects: the left hand grips the roof ridge; the right holds a pencil of charcoal and taps the roof tile in time. Background: Below her the toll road with a thin line of small carts and oxen under dust, the twin bridge arches silver in a bright sky, swallows skimming the tiles beside her, and a pigeon coop on the next roof; a ladder leans against the eave. Light: bright noon sun from the upper left, the tiles glaring pale beneath her and long sharp shadows under the eaves. Expression: a quick, busy, trusting look with the lips parted as she counts, the bright eyes fixed on the road below and a small frown of concentration. A faint earth-brown tint.

people.imagined: Remembered: the exile leader on the road to Phong Lâm, a family's worth of people behind him and swallows overhead, looking back once at the land he will not name.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait of the clan's leader at forty-five on a road, a small wooden box carried in both hands, looking back over his shoulder with a calm unreadable face as swallows fly over. Face: a long, grave, scholarly face; pale skin, tired; deep dark eyes; straight thick brows; a high-bridged nose; a firm closed mouth; a short black beard with a streak of grey. Hair: black, tied in a scholar's knot with a simple black ribbon. Body: tall, thin, upright. His stance is upright but tired, a weight in the shoulders; behind him a line of small figures with bundles on their backs, two children and an old woman on a donkey, drawn tiny. Clothing: a long robe of dark blue-grey cloth, once very fine and now carefully mended with matching thread, clean; wide sleeves; a plain belt. A black bamboo fan is in his belt and the box he carries is lacquered black with a small dull brass catch. Hands and objects: both hands hold a small flat dark box close to his chest; three small swallows circle over his head; a bamboo fan tucked in his belt. Background: The road is pale and dusty and runs to a thin horizon where a line of low hills shows pale blue; dozens of swallows wheel against the grey-gold sky and one lands on the box; a dead tree stands at the roadside with a single green shoot. Light: grey-gold light from the upper left. Expression: a grave, patient look over the shoulder, the dark eyes tired and unblinking and the closed mouth giving nothing away, a man who will not forget. The whole picture faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. A faint blue-grey tint.

people.imagined: In his study under the swallow's nest, brush lifted over a sheet, answering a letter in the clan's formal hand while two swallows chatter above the door.
people.subject: The moment: seated upright at a low desk under a swallow's nest, a fine brush lifted. Face: a thin, upright, refined old face, skin pale and fine; sharp, intelligent dark eyes with a haughty lift; thin white brows; a long straight nose; a thin dry mouth; a long thin white beard to the chest. Hair: white, in a tight topknot with a black lacquer pin. Body: thin, very upright, narrow-shouldered, sitting with the stillness of a man trained from childhood, his back not touching the chair and his wrist raised to keep the sleeve off the paper. Clothing: a long robe of dark blue-grey silk, old and fine, its seams re-stitched so finely that the stitching reads as embroidery, with tiny blue-grey swallows and clouds in matching thread; a high collar; a black sash. Hands and objects: the right hand lifts a long brush; the left holds a black bamboo fan painted with small swallows; his fingers are long and pale, with a callus at the side of the middle finger and a single ink stain; on the desk a stone ink block. Background: a study with a carved lintel, a low window of white paper with the shadow of a pine branch, a shelf of identical black-covered letter boxes, a small bronze incense burner with a thin line of smoke, and above the door the mud cup of a swallow's nest with a chick's beak showing. Light: soft light from the upper left. Expression: a proud, still, composed look, the dark eyes lifted with a faint haughtiness and the dry mouth patient and thin. A faint blue-grey tint.

people.imagined: At a classroom door, a child's slate under his arm, bending to a small pupil with ink-stained cuffs, with his soft voice and a gentle hidden lie about to leave his lips.
people.subject: The moment: bending slightly at a classroom door, a slate under one arm, listening to a small child. Face: a soft, kind, thin face; warm brown eyes; thin gentle brows; a straight nose; a small kind mouth; a few early lines. Hair: black, tied loosely in a scholar's knot. Body: slender, slightly stooped. Clothing: a blue-grey robe of fine cloth, clean, with both cuffs stained with black ink, plainly visible. The left sleeve has a long grey smear of chalk, and the slate under his arm has a picture of a bird, not letters. A small paper swallow is pinned to his collar. Hands and objects: a child's small slate under the left arm; the right hand holds a brush; a child's hand tugs his sleeve. He leans a little to the child's height with his hands on his knees, a posture of long habit; he has the slight stoop of a man who has bent to children for twenty years. Background: Behind him the school door opens onto a room with rows of low desks, a morning sun slanting across slates, a wooden swallow carved over the lintel, and a girl with a plait waiting in the doorway; a pot of chrysanthemums stands on the sill. Light: soft light from the upper left. Expression: a gentle, patient look, the head tilted to the child's height and the soft mouth smiling a little, a trace of something concealed behind the kindness. A faint blue-grey tint.

people.imagined: At the swallow nests under the eaves, smiling up with feathers pinned in her hair, mulberry pollen in the creases of her smile, a thin account-book under one arm.
people.subject: The moment: standing under eaves, smiling up at a row of swallows' nests. Face: a soft, warm, round face; kind dark eyes; thin brows; a small nose; a wide gentle smile with yellow pollen in the smile creases; laugh lines. Hair: grey-black, in a loose bun with three small swallow feathers pinned in. Body: plump, comfortable. Clothing: a plain, clean pale-green robe of good cloth with a blue-grey apron; a sash. The green robe has a plain brown border, the blue-grey apron is faded at the pockets, and the sleeves are pushed up showing sun-brown forearms; she wears a thin string of wooden beads. Hands and objects: one hand lifted toward a nest; the other holds a thin book of accounts. Her hands are broad, soft and warm-looking, holding the little account book against her hip with a stub of pencil tied to it by a string. Background: Overhead the eaves of a mud-brick hall hold eleven mud nests in a row, each with a small dark opening; swallows dart in and out; below, the earth is swept clean in a neat circle, and a small ladder leans against the wall beside a pail of water. Light: warm light from the upper left. Expression: a wide, gentle, contented smile with the laugh lines deep and the head tipped back, delighted by the nests. A faint soft green.

people.imagined: In the maple grove, calling a stranger friend with a flash of gold tooth, both sleeves stained with sap, as he lays an arm round a sap-boiler's shoulder.
people.subject: The moment: laying a friendly arm round a stranger's shoulder, grinning wide so that a gold tooth flashes. Face: a round, shiny, jovial face; clever small eyes; thick brows; a flat nose; a big grin with a gold front tooth, plainly drawn. Hair: black, oiled, in a topknot with a red cord. Body: stocky, hearty. Clothing: a fine maple-red robe of good cloth with wide sleeves, both sleeves stained with sticky amber sap; a broad belt with a copper clasp. He leans forward with a confident, shoulder-clapping posture, his big belly pushed out over the belt; the gold tooth is on the upper left. The robe's wide sleeves hang heavy with sap, the amber stains shiny and dark; a copper clasp on the belt is shaped like a leaf, and his fingers have rings of sticky amber. Hands and objects: the right arm round a blurred shoulder; the left holds a small amber-filled jar. Background: Behind them is a slope of maples blazing red and gold, wooden sap buckets hung on trunks, a thin trail of smoke from a boiling shed, and the blurred sap-boiler, a thin widow in a faded headcloth, looking down; fallen leaves cover the path. Light: warm autumn light from the upper left. Expression: a hearty, gold-toothed grin with the small eyes shrewd and gleaming, the friendliness of a man who is already measuring your pockets. A faint warm amber.

people.imagined: At a table with a tea cup, her left hand held in her lap, five rings on it glittering whenever she moves; she looks bored at the old name on the wall.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a table, her left hand lifted off the table edge to show five rings, a small cold smile. Face: a sharp, handsome, powdered face; cold narrow eyes; thin arched brows; a thin nose; a thin red mouth. Hair: black with grey, piled high with silver pins. Body: slim, upright, poised. The five rings are gold with a red stone, a green stone, a plain band, a twisted band and a pearl. Clothing: a deep jade-green robe of fine silk with silver edging, high collar; a jade bracelet on the right. At the neck of the robe a thin silver chain rests. Hands and objects: the left hand has five rings on five fingers, gold and silver, large in the lower frame; the right hand bare, hidden under the table. She sits at an angle with her right hand carefully out of sight and her chin lifted a little; her left hand is held out like an object on display, the wrist bent. Background: The room behind has three pale rectangles on the wall where something once hung, a lacquered table with a single teacup, a half-empty sideboard with a gap in a row of silver spoons, and a kitchen girl in the doorway in the blur, her head bowed. Light: cool light from the upper left. Expression: a bored, cold, small smile with the narrow eyes half-lidded, the face of a woman showing off her wealth and counting what is missing. A faint green.

people.imagined: Midway through a lesson, a stick of chalk snapping in his fingers, white dust on the left sleeve, bench creaking beneath him, smiling anyway.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a blackboard, a piece of chalk snapping in his hand, a small startled smile. Face: a mild, thin, kind face; light brown eyes; soft brows; a long nose; a modest smile; a smear of chalk on the cheek. Hair: brown, tied back. Body: tall, lanky, slightly stooped. Clothing: a clean blue-grey robe of good cloth, the sleeves a little short, chalk dust thick across the left sleeve and one elbow re-stitched in careful matching thread; a leather satchel at his hip and a third whole piece of chalk sticking out of his sash. Hands and objects: the right hand holds two halves of broken chalk delicately, as if trying to join them; behind him a bench with a cracked leg propped on a bundle of folded cloth. Background: The classroom has a plain board wall with simple birds sketched in white chalk, rows of low benches with one propped on a book, slates stacked in a corner, dust motes in a shaft of window light, and a small wooden crane on the teacher's table. Light: soft light from the upper left. Expression: a small, startled, rueful smile, the brows lifted and the eyes soft, a mild man caught out by his own clumsiness. A faint blue-grey tint.

people.imagined: Sitting with her back as stiff as her grandfather's, looking straight at whoever is speaking, a page of her cousin's copying in her hand, deciding whether to praise or tear it.
people.subject: The moment: sitting bolt upright, holding a page of writing, looking straight at the viewer. Face: a thin, bright, handsome young face; direct dark eyes; strong straight brows; a straight nose; a firm young mouth. Hair: black, in a tight high knot with a swallow-feather pin. Body: slim and stiff-backed, chin level; her back is a ruler-straight copy of her grandfather's, shoulders pinned back, feet flat, and her head cocked fractionally to one side as she measures a person. Clothing: a crisp clean blue-grey robe of fine cloth with a high collar and a narrow sash tied in a flat square knot; a hairpin shaped like a goose feather. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a sheet of paper with drawn black marks between thumb and forefinger as if about to tear it, the knuckles white; the left hand lies flat on her knee. Background: Behind her a study with a painted screen of reeds and flying geese, a low desk with a half-burnt page curled in a dish, an ink stone, a brush rack, and the shadow of a swallow on the paper wall; a small brazier smokes quietly. Light: soft light from the upper left. Expression: an unblinking, level stare with the chin up and the mouth shut hard, the look of a girl who has already decided what she will be and is judging whether the viewer is of any use. A faint blue-grey tint.

people.imagined: Alone at night with a stack of sealed letters, a pen clenched in her teeth, bitten nails on the paper, ink on her lips, noticing something wrong with a handwriting.
people.subject: The moment: bent over a letter at night, a pen clamped in her teeth, eyes wide. Face: a pale, thin, worried face; wide dark eyes; thin brows pulled up; a small nose; ink stains on her lips. Hair: black, tied up loosely. Body: thin and hunched, bent so low that the light shows the down on her cheek; her left foot is tucked under her and the right toe taps nervously. Clothing: a neat blue-grey robe of fine cloth with loose sleeves pushed past the elbow and a smear of ink along the left forearm. Hands and objects: both hands hold a thin letter up to the lamp, the nails bitten to the quick; a second letter lies unfolded under her elbow and a third, sealed with plain wax, by the lamp. Background: Around her a dark room with a heap of letters tied in bundles, an open chest, a window with a thin moon, a half-empty teacup gone cold, and on the wall her own shadow huge and still; an owl's cry could be imagined beyond the paper pane. Light: warm lamp light from the lower right. Expression: wide, frightened, hungry eyes, the brows pulled up and the pen clamped hard in her teeth, the look of someone reading something twice to be sure. A faint blue-grey tint.

people.imagined: Remembered: the paddy-clearer at the first great harvest, standing knee-deep in gold rice with a sickle held loosely, content.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait of the first harvest-bringer at fifty, standing in a field of ripe gold rice, a sickle held loosely at his side, smiling. Face: a broad, kind, sun-weathered face; warm brown eyes crinkled; thick brows; a short nose; a wide easy smile; a short grey beard. Hair: grey, in a topknot under a conical straw hat pushed back. Body: stout, strong and relaxed, standing with his weight on one leg, the sickle hanging point down. Clothing: a plain brown jacket of good cloth, clean, the sleeves rolled above muscled forearms freckled with mud, a stitched line of blue thread at the shoulder where a seam was reset; rolled trousers muddy to the knee; a belt of twisted rice-straw cord; bare feet deep in the golden stalks; the conical straw hat's brim bent and bleached pale by sun. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a bright curved sickle; the left a handful of rice heads. Background: Behind him a wide plain of heavy golden rice heads bending in rows to a flat horizon, a few harvesters in the distance bent double, a grey heron standing in a flooded corner, and a pale sky with soft cloud banks; a stack of sheaves stands to one side. Light: warm golden light from the upper left. Expression: a wide, easy, contented smile, the eyes crinkled, a man pleased with the field and the people it will feed. The whole picture faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. A faint gold-green tint.

people.imagined: Harvest morning at the great granary door. He has scooped a handful of rice from an open sack and is weighing it in his palm by eye, rain-cape of straw still on his shoulders over a silk robe, knowing the number before anyone tells him.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a granary door at first light, a handful of pale rice lifted on his open palm, his eyes narrowed in judgement. Face: a big, square, deeply sun-darkened face, skin nearly the colour of dark tea; heavy straight black-and-grey brows; small shrewd brown eyes under lowered lids, calm and exact; a thick nose; a wide closed mouth with the corners drawn down; a short grey-flecked beard clipped square along the jaw. Hair: grey-black, thick, tied up in a plain knot at the crown with a strip of brown cloth. Body: a big, heavy, solid farmer, very broad in the shoulders and chest, thick neck, standing planted with his weight low. Clothing: a long straw rain cape of pale golden rice-straw laid over his shoulders in overlapping layers, the biggest shape in the frame; beneath it, showing at chest and wrists, a robe of fine dark-green silk with a crossed collar and narrow cuffs, very clean; a wide leather belt with a plain iron buckle; on his left breast, hanging from a cord, a small round clay-coloured seal and a tiny bronze bell. Hands and objects: the right hand lifts a heap of pale rice grains on its flat palm to eye level, a few grains falling; the left rests on the rim of a deep sack of rice. Background: the dark open doors of a long granary with stacked sacks, a wet courtyard, and a row of blurred tenant figures waiting at the edge. Light: cool pale dawn light from the upper left, a thin warm gleam on the grains. Expression: calm, cautious, quietly acquisitive. A faint blue-green water and green-wood tint in the air.

people.imagined: A muddy road on the way to a pill-broker. The cart has lost a wheel again. He sits on the cart's tilted bed in muddy trousers, looking at the wheel with the long patience of a man who has seen this before, not at all surprised.
people.subject: The moment: sitting on the edge of a tilted cart on a muddy road, looking at a fallen wheel lying in the mud with weary patience. Face: a long, tired, greying face that looks older than it should; skin dull brown with deep lines under the eyes and along the cheeks; thin grey brows; mild, patient brown eyes with heavy pouches; a long straight nose; a closed mouth with a faint resigned smile; a thin grey beard, sparse. Hair: grey, thin, drawn back and tied at the nape, a few strands escaping across the temple. Body: tall, lean, stooped, long hands, narrow chest. Clothing: a plain robe of good dark-green hemp, clean at the collar but caked in mud to the knee; a straw cape pushed back off one shoulder; a brown cloth belt; leather shoes thick with mud. Hands and objects: the right hand rests on his knee holding a small, tightly tied cloth bundle, the family's money for a pill; the left hand points loosely at the lost wheel. Background: a flat wet paddy landscape under a heavy sky, the cart's single ox looking back at him, the broken wheel half-sunk in a puddle. Light: dull flat grey-white light from the upper left. Expression: patient, resigned, a trace of private calculation. A faint damp blue-green tint.

people.imagined: At a merchant's counter. She weighs a silver coin on her thumb, nods, and slides over twice the price. The pearls in her ears catch the lamp. Her husband's father does not know.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a market counter, weighing a small silver coin on the pad of her thumb before pushing a heavy purse across to someone out of frame. Face: a handsome, narrow, fine-boned face; fair skin with a warm flush; large dark eyes, direct, honest and tense; thin, arched brows; a straight nose; a firm, slightly pressed mouth; no lines but one small crease between the brows. Hair: glossy black, in a smooth coil pinned high with two silver pins. Body: slim, upright, quick. Clothing: a robe of fine dove-grey silk with a modest crossed collar and narrow sleeves, a sash of deep green, plainly well made but not showy; in her ears, a pair of large round white pearls, far too fine for the house, the brightest points in the picture. Hands and objects: her right thumb and forefinger hold up a bright silver coin; the left hand pushes forward a round brown leather purse bulging with coin; at her hip a short straight sword in a plain scabbard. Background: a dim shop of shelves and jars, a hanging lamp, a blurred shopkeeper's hand. Light: warm lamp light from the upper left, glints on the pearls and the silver. Expression: tense, loyal, determined, a little guilty. A faint cold metal gleam of silver in the air.

people.imagined: Beside the Tower's tall counters at harvest. He has dozed off over the count with his chin on his chest, a tally stick behind one ear, and opens one eye in a reverent squint when a counter strides past.
people.subject: The moment: sitting on a stool at a harvest counting table, half-dozing, one eye cracked open in a reverent squint at a tall official passing in the blur. Face: a soft, round, easy face; pale brown skin; heavy drooping lids; a short wide nose; a small slack mouth with a trace of drool; plump cheeks; thin sparse brows; a day's grey stubble. Hair: dark, thinning, tied in a small loose knot; a short wooden tally stick tucked behind the right ear, notched along one edge. Body: soft, wide-hipped, round-shouldered, slouched. Clothing: a clean robe of mid-green silk, well cut, with a loosened sash; a short straw cape across the shoulders; a leather purse; sandals. Hands and objects: the right hand lies loose on a long table beside a pile of notched sticks; the left holds a stick of bamboo upright as if forgetting it; his fingers are thick and soft. Background: a courtyard of stacked sacks and tall wooden counting frames hung with notched sticks, a bright striped awning, a pair of sparrows on a sack, and a blurred young man in the corner signing sticks. Light: soft warm light from the upper left. Expression: a sleepy, slack, trusting look, the heavy lids drooping and one eye cracked open with reverent awe at the passing official. A faint green-wood tint.

people.imagined: Dusk on the far bank, where the fields stayed dry. He stands at the edge of a cracked paddy with a hoe, grey dust in his eyebrows, looking across a river where the rice is green.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a dry, cracked paddy at dusk, leaning on a hoe, looking across a river at green fields on the far bank. Face: a lean, brown, kind face, lined; grey dust lying in his thick eyebrows like frost, plain and big; steady dark eyes; a straight nose; a firm, closed mouth; a rough grey stubble. Hair: grey-brown, cut short, under a wide straw hat pushed back. Body: lean and tough, narrow-hipped, with a worker's slight stoop; he grips the hoe with both fists low on the handle, its blade resting in a crack wide enough to take a finger. Clothing: a plain, clean brown farmer's jacket of good cloth with a neatly mended collar and the sleeves rolled up; rolled trousers, the knees dusted pale; a coil of rope over one shoulder and a water gourd on a cord at the hip; bare feet grey with dust, his boots left on the bank. Hands and objects: both hands wrap the handle of a hoe; the brown skin is cracked across every knuckle, plain to see. Background: cracked pale earth in the foreground, a wide slow river, and across it green rice and a lit house. In the distance on the far bank, a lit window, a line of green rows, a plume of cook-smoke; around him on this side the earth is the colour of old bone with cracks in a web pattern, a dried-up irrigation channel, and a few dead stalks standing; the river is silver and slow between. Light: low orange dusk light from the upper left. Expression: a quiet, steady, unyielding gaze across the water, the mouth shut firm and the eyes soft with something like pity. A faint dry earth-yellow tint.

people.imagined: Beside a row of small mounds. She does not look away from the visitor. Her grey streaks are loose in the wind. She wants to know why only one bank had rain.
people.subject: The moment: standing beside a row of small earthen mounds in a paddy, staring straight at the viewer without blinking. Face: a lean, strong, brown face with high cheekbones; deep dark eyes with a hard, steady, unblinking stare; straight black brows; a firm straight nose; a thin mouth held still; fine lines at the eyes. Hair: black with wide streaks of grey from both temples, left unhidden, tied back low with a plain strip of cloth. Body: slim, upright, strong forearms. Clothing: a clean, fine dark-blue-green cloth jacket in a landlord-house cut, a high stiff collar embroidered with a narrow pattern of waves in a lighter thread, a gift of the house that does not quite suit her; a plain brown cotton skirt to the ankle; a white cloth mourning band at the upper left arm; bare feet on the earth. Hands and objects: both hands folded in front, the right over the left, brown and cracked; at her feet a small bundle of herbs and a small clay cup beside the mounds. Background: At her feet two small low mounds with a few sprigs of dried grass on top and a chipped cup between them, and farther on a green paddy that ends at a river whose far bank is dry and pale; a single crow sits on a stake, and the sky is a thin colourless grey. Light: pale grey light from the upper left. Expression: an unblinking, steady stare with the thin mouth held still, a long cold patience that has stopped hoping and not stopped waiting. A faint cool green tint.

people.imagined: On a stone road at the Tower's gate, carrying a bundle of letters for his cousin. His landlord's boots pinch his feet; his tenant's heels hurt in them; he is smiling at everyone anyway.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a road carrying a bundle of letters, smiling broadly, his feet in boots that are visibly too small. Face: a young, open, round-cheeked face; sun-browned; warm eager brown eyes; thick brows; a wide nose; a broad friendly smile; light stubble. Hair: black, short and untidy, a bit of straw in it. Body: stocky, strong and easy, slightly bowed, with a rolling step as if his feet hurt, the toes of the boots curling up and his thick cracked heels bulging at the back of each. Clothing: a good jacket of dark-green cloth in a landlord's cut, clean and fitted, the cuffs rolled once to show a green silk lining; a short strap of the letter satchel across his chest; plain brown trousers; boots of fine black leather a size too small, the toes turned up. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a bundle of folded letters tied with a red cord; the left lifts in greeting. Background: A stone-paved road leads up to a tall grey gate with a roof of dark tiles at the top of a flight of steps; two guards in grey stand at the gate far away; pink blossom fills the hedge along the road, and a tenant's cart rattles by, drawn as a shape. Light: bright morning light from the upper left. Expression: a wide, open, trusting grin showing a gap in his teeth, the eyes bright and eager to be liked, with no hint that his feet hurt. A faint green tint.

people.imagined: In a mirror's reflection she will not meet. She looks past it, tight-lipped, with a letter folded in her sleeve offering something she should not offer.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a plain room with her mouth drawn tight, her face turned away from a bronze mirror beside her, a letter's edge showing in her sleeve. Face: a pale, narrow, angular young face; eyes of a cold grey, her mother's, drawn plain and big; thin, hard, level brows; a thin straight nose; lips pressed into a tight line; a faint spot of angry colour on each cheekbone. Hair: black, pulled back tight into a single hard knot with a plain iron pin. Body: slim, rigid and upright, the shoulders square, the chin held a little too high. Clothing: a fine, clean, plain robe of dark-green cloth with a high collar and narrow sleeves, the folded edge of a letter showing at the left cuff; a belt with a short plain sword. Hands and objects: the right hand grips the hilt of the sword at her belt, the knuckles pale; the left sleeve hides a folded letter; on the table beside her the bronze mirror lies tilted, the fingers of her left hand just short of it. Background: a bare room with a low table, a bronze mirror on it tilted so it shows only a dark shape, a bar of cool window light across the plain boards, a single hard-backed chair and a closed chest against a whitewashed wall. Light: cold light from the upper left. Expression: stiff and resentful, the lips pressed to a thin line and a faint spot of angry colour on each cheekbone, her head turned from the mirror as if it had insulted her. A faint cold metal-grey tint.

people.imagined: In the granary by lamplight, counting sacks under his breath instead of humming, flour on his fingers, squinting at a stack. He knows exactly what the Tower never sees.
people.subject: The moment: in a granary at night, pointing at stacked sacks one by one with a rice-floured finger, lips moving as he counts. Face: a mild, round, honest face; soft brown eyes squinting against lamplight; thin even brows; a short nose; a calm mouth moving through numbers; a trace of white flour on the cheek. Hair: black, short, tied in a small knot. He leans close to the stack, shoulders forward, one foot on a low stool; flour has settled in his hair and eyebrows in fine white, and a grey rat's tail pokes from behind a sack in the shadows. Body: medium, soft-shouldered, neat. Clothing: a clean, plain robe of mid-green cloth with a flour-dusted apron; sleeves tied back with cord. The apron has a patch sewn with big stitches and a small bone counter, one for each hundred sacks, hangs from his belt. Hands and objects: all the fingers of the right hand are white with rice flour, large in the picture; the left holds a small clay oil lamp. Background: The stacks of sacks climb to the rafters in tidy rows, each row tied with a different coloured string, rice dust floating in the lamp's glow, a heavy iron-banded door ajar to the night, and a tally board with rows of drawn dots and no writing hanging on a nail. Light: warm yellow lamp light from the lower left. Expression: a careful, kind look, the lips moving over the count and the soft eyes squinting against the lamp, quietly weighing every sack. A faint warm grain-gold tint.

people.imagined: Remembered: the captain on the new white-sand jetty he built, a bride's family behind him, his hand on a mooring post, proud, sea behind.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait of a sea captain at forty, standing proud on a new wooden jetty with one hand on a mooring post, wind in his coat. Face: a bold, weathered, handsome face; skin deep tan; bright blue-grey eyes narrowed against sun; thick dark brows; a straight nose; a broad confident smile; a short black beard with a few grey hairs. Hair: black, tied back in a sailor's tail with a blue cloth. Body: tall, broad-shouldered, upright. Clothing: a captain's coat of dark-blue cloth with brass buttons, fine and clean, over a white shirt with an open collar; a red sash; a large gold ring on the right hand. The coat's brass buttons are polished bright, the collar turned up against the wind, the gold ring flashing; his hair whips to the left. Beside him on the jetty stands a small chest with a ship's lantern on it, and behind him, at a respectful distance, a young woman in a pale sea-green dress and a headscarf watches him, drawn small. Hands and objects: the right hand grips a mooring post of pale new timber; the left hand points to sea. Background: a long white-sand beach, the new jetty, three tall ships riding far out, a pale sky. The sea beyond is a wide band of pale turquoise, the sand dazzling white, three high-masted ships with cream sails riding low and heavy far out, gulls wheeling, and a sky of bright high cloud; the new jetty's planks are pale and still smell of resin. Light: bright sea light from the upper left. Expression: a bold, confident, joyous grin, the eyes narrowed against sun and wind and the whole face lifted toward the sea. The whole picture faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. A faint sea-blue tint.

people.imagined: At a bargaining table on the quay, a rod case at his belt, eyes on the sky over the buyer's head, mid-sentence, reading weather in the haze while pricing a cargo.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a bargaining table on a quay, head tilted up to watch the sky while a hand rests on a small counting-rod case. Face: a small, quick, lined face; weathered brown skin; bright brown eyes tilted to the sky, a little amused; thin dark brows; a short nose; a thin mouth about to quote a price; a trim grey-black beard. Hair: black with grey, in a plain topknot. Body: small, wiry and quick, neatly seated with his head tipped back to the sky. Clothing: a plain robe of pale sandy sailcloth, the colour of the beach, clean and simply cut, with a crossed collar; a plain brown belt with a bamboo counting-rod case hung from it; on his right hand a heavy plain ring. Hands and objects: the right hand rests on the rod case; the left holds, flat, a small round bronze mirror, its face turned toward the sky; his fingers are brown, dry and nimble. Background: a busy quay of stacked crates, coiled rope and tall masts, porters in conical hats passing with baskets, a bargaining table with a small brass scale, and a bright cloudy sky with one line of haze on the horizon. Light: bright salt-bleached light from the upper left. Expression: a friendly, amused half-smile with the eyes narrowed at the sky, a trader about to quote a price and already sure of it. A faint sea-blue water gleam.

people.imagined: On the deck of the flagship at the rail, shouting an order up the mast in a voice made for it, white beard whipping, jaw set against the second holds he hates.
people.subject: The moment: at a ship's rail in wind, one hand cupped to his mouth, bellowing an order up the mast. Face: a weathered, hard, strong face; deep tan; narrow grey eyes; thick white brows; a big nose; a wide open mouth; a full, bright salt-white beard blown sideways. Hair: white and cropped, a faded blue cap. Body: tall, broad, long-armed, a captain's stance. Clothing: a long coat of fine dark-blue cloth with a high collar, clean and well cut, over a white shirt; a leather belt with a short sword; salt on the shoulders. His coat flaps wide and the long sleeves are tied back with cord; the sword at his belt has a plain steel guard; the white beard is full and long, streaming sideways and wet with spray. His boots are sea-boots of soft leather with grips, spread wide on the deck, and a rope is wound round his left wrist. Hands and objects: the left hand cupped at his mouth; the right grips a rope. Background: Behind him the main mast with huge taut cream sail, men in dark jackets hauling lines, a following ship low in the water on the grey swell, a pale seabird crossing the sky and the horizon tilted with the roll of the ship; a barrel is lashed to the rail. Light: strong cold light from the upper left. Expression: a stern, furious, bellowing look, the wide mouth open and the narrow grey eyes fierce under the white brows. A faint sea-blue tint.

people.imagined: In the warehouse aisle. She keeps a shawl on indoors, hands tucked in it, counting crates without opening them, careful not to ask.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a dim warehouse aisle in a shawl, one hand on a crate, careful not to look inside. Face: a quiet, pale, narrow face half in shadow; careful dark eyes cast down; thin straight brows; a small nose; a closed mouth. Hair: black with a few strands of grey at the temples, in a plain tidy knot with a dark pin. Body: slight and upright, perfectly still, the shawl held shut across her chest. Clothing: a fine grey-brown robe, clean, with a high collar and narrow cuffs, under a thick brown wool shawl with a darker border wrapped over the shoulders and held closed at the throat with a plain wooden pin; at her waist a small ring of keys and a bag of pine-soot crayons. Hands and objects: the right palm, held up from the shawl, has pine-soot black in every groove of the skin, plain and big. Background: The warehouse stretches away with towering stacks of pale crates tied with rope, each marked with a small painted dot of a different colour, hanging oil lamps at intervals, a door standing open to a dark quay, and a cold draught lifting her shawl's fringe. Light: dim lamp light from the upper left. Expression: a careful, lowered, closed look, the eyes fixed on the crate's edge and never on what is inside it, the mouth still. A faint grey-brown tint.

people.imagined: At dawn on a balcony with a brush, composing a poem, eyes drifting to the ceiling halfway through a sentence, ink on his cuffs.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a low table at dawn, brush lifted, eyes drifting up to the ceiling. Face: a soft, fine, dreamy face; fair skin; far-off grey eyes; thin brows; a long nose; a gentle half-smile; a thin moustache. Hair: black with grey, loose to the shoulder, a loose band. Body: tall, slim, relaxed. Clothing: a loose poet's robe of fine blue-grey silk with a collar hanging open; both cuffs stained with black ink, plain and big; a loose sash. He sits cross-legged with his back against a pillar and one knee raised to rest his arm; his loose collar shows a thin neck and a pale chest. Ink has run along the heel of his hand and in a long streak down both cuffs; a bowl of cold tea and a half-eaten rice cake sit forgotten. A small wooden fish hangs from his belt. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a brush; the left holds a blank sheet. Background: The balcony looks over a slate-blue harbour with masts like a thicket, a pearl-pink dawn along the horizon, gulls on the rail, a hanging basket of sea-pinks, and a scatter of blank sheets weighted with stones; the brush rack is a little bamboo boat. Light: pale pink light from the upper left. Expression: a dreamy, easy half-smile, the far-off grey eyes drifting to the ceiling and the face quite unaware of the ink on his hand. A faint sea-blue tint.

people.imagined: On the quay, hands cupped, calling across the harbour for a ship, her pilot's squint narrowing as she judges the wind.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a quay, calling across the harbour at the top of her voice, squinting. Face: a strong, brown, weathered face; narrowed grey-brown eyes in a permanent pilot's squint with deep crow's-feet; thick straight brows; a short nose; a wide mouth open mid-shout. Hair: black-grey, tied under a blue head-scarf. Body: sturdy, broad-shouldered, stands braced. Clothing: a short dark-blue jacket of fine cloth, clean, with a double row of horn buttons and a standing collar, the sleeves rolled to the elbow; a white scarf at the neck flapping; trousers tied at the knee; grey sealskin boots; a brass whistle on a cord. Hands and objects: both hands cupped at her mouth; her forearms are brown and strong with a pale scar across the left. Background: The harbour mouth is a wide basin with a mole of pale stone, a red-sailed lugger coming in on a following wind, a line of small boats waiting, spray on the stone, and two gulls hanging motionless in the air; the sky is high pale blue with long streaks of cloud. Light: bright wind-swept light from the upper left. Expression: a fierce, impatient squint with the wide mouth thrown open, the face of a pilot who is never afraid of the water and is out of patience with the boat. A faint sea-blue tint.

people.imagined: Across a desk, reading a ledger upside down, an ink smudge under her left eye, frowning at figures that stop matching.
people.subject: The moment: leaning across a desk, reading a ledger upside down, a small frown. Face: a thin, clever, young face; sharp dark eyes; level thin brows pulled in; a small nose; a closed mouth; a small black ink fingerprint smudged under the left eye. Hair: black, in a long braid pinned up with a wooden stick. Body: slim, leaning forward. Clothing: a clean grey-blue robe of good cloth, the sleeves pushed to the elbow in neat folds, a narrow belt with a tiny brass abacus charm. Hands and objects: her hands are long and neat; the right forefinger runs down a column of small drawn marks while the left holds a second ledger open at a different page. Background: The office has a high window with a view of masts, a wall of numbered pigeonholes full of rolled charts, a brass lamp, a second desk piled with sealed packets, a map of the coast, and a tiny model ship on the sill; a cup of cold tea stands at her elbow. Light: soft light from the upper left. Expression: a small, sharp frown with the brows drawn in and the lips pursed, the look of someone hunting a sum that refuses to add. A faint sea-grey tint.

people.imagined: At the oars of a big boat, laughing a laugh that clacks like a rowlock, a song half sung.
people.subject: The moment: at the oars of a boat, laughing with his chest thrown out. Face: a broad, tanned, merry face; bright eyes; thick brows; a wide nose; a huge laughing mouth. Hair: black and curly, tied with a blue cloth knotted at the brow, salt drying in it. Body: a huge barrel chest thrust out so the jacket strains at its buttons, forearms thick as logs, the head thrown back so the throat shows; salt in his hair. Clothing: a short sea-blue jacket of fine cloth trimmed in white braid, open at the chest, clean; a yellow sash; a rowlock-shaped bronze charm on a chain. Hands and objects: both hands on an oar, the wooden grip lost in his fist; his teeth are large and square. Background: a white-sand beach curving behind him in a long pale arc, women with baskets on the shore, a low whitewashed town, wheeling gulls, the flat bright sea with a line of oars rising and falling in the blur, and a cloudless pale sky. Light: bright sun from the upper left, hard sparkling highlights on the wet oar blade and the sea behind him. Expression: a huge, merry, open-mouthed laugh with the eyes screwed shut, a man happy with the water and his own strength. A faint sea-blue tint.

people.imagined: Standing straight outside a school gate, as if someone might stop looking, a long nose and a chin scar, wanting the place her brother keeps leaving.
people.subject: The moment: standing very straight outside a school gate, chin lifted. Face: a plain, long-nosed, earnest young face; a small pale scar across the chin; steady grey eyes; thin brows; a firm mouth. Hair: black, in a tidy braid. Body: slim, straight. She stands like a post, shoulders squared, heels together, as though trying to look as sturdy as she can; her long nose is prominent and the scar on her chin a thin white crescent. Clothing: a clean grey robe of fine cloth, neat. The grey robe is plain and spotless, the sleeves precisely folded, the collar flat; a small jade pendant shaped like a fish hangs from her clasped hands and her eyes do not blink. Hands and objects: both hands folded in front, holding a jade pendant. Background: A tall gate of grey stone with a tiled roof and wooden doors half open on a courtyard of pale gravel, a plum tree in the courtyard, two older students passing in grey robes in the blur, a stone step worn smooth, and a cool pale sky; a path of pebbles leads up to her feet. Light: soft light from the upper left. Expression: an earnest, humble look with the chin lifted, the eyes steady and a little over-bright, the mouth firm with effort. A faint sea-blue tint.

people.imagined: Remembered: the silk trader among piled cocoons, hands full, bargaining with a picker and laughing.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait of a silk trader at fifty, seated heavy and comfortable, weighing a basket of white cocoons in both hands with a broad laugh. Face: a warm, round, tanned face; bright eyes crinkled; thick brows; a short nose; a huge generous smile; a short grey beard. Hair: grey, tied up with a yellow cord. Body: stout and jolly, the belly resting on the knees, one sleeve rolled to show a thick forearm. Clothing: a fine, glossy robe of cream silk with a pattern of small silkworm shapes and a wide gold-yellow belt, clean. Hands and objects: both hands hold a basket of cocoons, white and round as eggs, a few spilling over his fingers; a small iron scale hangs from a hook at his side. Background: The market behind him is a bright confusion of bamboo trays heaped with white and yellow cocoons, mulberry trees in leaf, pickers in broad hats arriving with baskets, a striped awning, and a bright warm sky; a boy carries a pole with two baskets across the foreground. Light: warm light from the upper left. Expression: a huge, generous, crinkle-eyed smile, a man delighted with the weight in his hands. The whole picture faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. A faint ember-gold tint.

people.imagined: At her reeling basin in the shed, a gold needle in her hair, burn scars on her small hands, shouting across the whole market through a window, a fine red thread running through her fingers.
people.subject: The moment: at a reeling basin, drawing a fine red thread through her fingers while calling out loudly through a window. Face: a small, sharp, handsome face; skin brown with pale burn scars at the jaw and temple; bright fierce dark eyes; strong straight brows; a small nose; a wide mouth open mid-call. Hair: black, in a high coil pinned with a golden needle. Body: small, wiry, quick. Clothing: a fine robe of deep crimson silk with the sleeves tied back, an apron; at the wrist a thimble of dark wood. The golden needle in her hair is as long as a finger, bright; her crimson robe has the sleeves tied back with yellow cords, a canvas apron over it, and the dark mulberry-wood thimble gleams on her right middle finger. Hands and objects: both hands are marked with fine pale burn scars, plain; they draw a red silk thread from a steaming basin. She stands on tiptoe a little, leaning out toward the window with one hand gripping the basin's rim; steam wets her face and the loose hair at her temples. Background: The shed behind her holds a row of round copper basins, each with a rising plume of steam, silk reels turning, red and white threads strung across the rafters like a web, a girl at the next basin in blur, and through the window the bustle of the silk market in the sun. Light: warm orange steam-lit light from the upper left. Expression: a fierce, proud, wrathful look, the mouth open in a shout and the eyes blazing, her hands still gentle on the thread. A faint ember tint.

people.imagined: At the market table in good brocade, a smooth soft smile, a cup of tea, never raising his voice and never lowering his price first.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a market table with a tea cup, smiling smoothly. Face: a soft, round, clean-shaven face; pale skin; calm, bland, clever eyes; thin smooth brows; a short nose; a small pleasant smile. Hair: black, oiled, held by a gold pin shaped like a moth. Body: round, soft, composed. Clothing: a fine robe of heavy dark-red brocade with a close pattern of tiny cocoons woven in gold thread, a high collar and wide sleeves lined in cream; on each thumb a plain jade ring. Hands and objects: both hands wrap a small tea cup, the little finger lifted; the hands are plump, soft and clean with neat nails. Background: The table before him is spread with three small bolts of silk in different reds, a tea tray, a pair of brass scales and a thin black abacus, behind it an awning striped red and cream, and beyond, the blur of the market crowd and the shape of an official in a green coat leaning over the table. Light: warm light from the upper left. Expression: a smooth, pleasant, closed smile with calm, bland eyes, friendly on the surface and totting up the table beneath it. A faint warm earth tint.

people.imagined: At the counting table, a bundle in her hand and a mood on her face, deciding by the day whether to credit or dock it.
people.subject: The moment: holding up a bundle of mulberry leaves, deciding with a scowl. Face: a lean, kind-looking, brown face; sharp eyes; thin brows; a long nose; a pressed mouth. Hair: grey-black, in a plain bun. Body: thin, wiry. She is thin and strong with a straight back, the right shoulder a little lower from carrying baskets; her face is calm but the mouth is set. Clothing: a clean robe of green cloth, the hem stained mulberry-green. The green robe has a grass-green stain along the hem that no washing removes, the sleeves are rolled up, her bare forearms are brown and wiry, and the swollen knuckles are as round as walnuts. A tally of notched sticks is tied at her belt. Hands and objects: the knuckles of both hands are swollen like walnuts, plain; the right holds a tally. Background: Behind her the low green rows of mulberry bushes stretch to the horizon in the sun, pickers in broad straw hats bend over them, baskets of bright green leaves wait at the row ends, and a thin woman in a grey headcloth stands off to the side with her empty basket, drawn blurred. Light: bright light from the upper left. Expression: a scowl of judgement, the brows low and the lips pushed forward, deciding with arbitrary weight whether the leaves are good enough. A faint green tint.

people.imagined: At a reeling basin, her fingers never still even when she looks up, as if reeling thread from the air.
people.subject: The moment: looking up from a basin while her fingers keep moving. Face: a quiet, thin, pale face; steady dark eyes; level brows; a small nose; a closed mouth. Hair: black, tied back neatly. Body: slim and still, sitting straight at the basin with the sleeves tied back and the wrists held loose and high, the fingers curled as if round a thread that is not there; the movement shows as faint repeated outlines. Clothing: a clean fine red-brown robe with an apron of pale cloth and a cord at the waist with a wooden thimble hung from it. Hands and objects: the fingers of both hands pinch the air as if drawing a thread, long, pale and dry, the nails cut short. Background: the reeling shed, a long row of copper basins with rising steam, red and white skeins hanging from poles overhead, a narrow window of white light, a younger girl in blur behind her carrying cocoons, and a door ajar to a cellar stair going down into darkness. Light: warm amber light from the upper left, with steam glowing white in the window. Expression: a calm, almost sleepy look with fine lines at the corners of the eyes, the face of a woman who keeps her thoughts the way she keeps her silk, wound tight and out of sight. A faint ember tint.

people.imagined: Practising a soldier's pose before a bronze mirror, a thin new moustache, blisters on both palms.
people.subject: The moment: standing proudly with a spear, a thin new moustache twirled between finger and thumb.
