Face: a young, eager, sun-flushed face; bright dark eyes; thick black brows; a thin wispy moustache barely there above a wide grin. Hair: black, tied high. Body: lean and strong, chest out and chin raised in imitation of a soldier, the spear grounded at his side. Clothing: a fine red-brown jacket cut like a soldier's with a high collar, leather bracers on both forearms and a wide belt with a brass buckle. Hands and objects: the right hand grips a spear; the first finger and thumb of the left stroke the thin moustache, a faint line of dark hair; each palm shows a red, shiny blister. Background: a packed-earth yard with a wooden practice post, a rack of wooden spears, a straw target, a low wall with silk-drying frames behind it and a flag on a pole snapping in the wind; an older woman in the doorway watches with folded arms, a blur. Light: bright afternoon light from the upper left. Expression: a proud, eager, slightly show-off grin with the chin lifted, a boy playing at being the soldier he hopes to become. A faint ember tint.

people.imagined: At the weavers' door, a bundle of samples in her arms, bracelets of silk thread on both wrists, a guilty glance.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a weavers' door with a bundle of cloth samples, a quick sideways glance. Face: a bright, pretty, round face; quick dark eyes with a teasing glint; high arched brows; a small nose; a half-smile on soft lips. Hair: black, in a loose braid with a coloured thread twisted through it and a few strands loose at the temples. Body: slim and quick, holding the bundle against her chest, one shoulder turned away and her head half-turned over it; her cheeks are flushed. Clothing: a light robe of red-brown gauze with long loose sleeves that show her forearms, over a plain cream dress with a bright blue sash. Hands and objects: on each wrist five or six silk-thread bracelets in blue, green, saffron, rose, black and white; both hands clutch the bundle of cloth samples. Background: a tall arched weavers' doorway with a bright interior behind it, a great loom with half-woven cloth in coloured stripes, women at benches in blur, a shed at the side with its door open, and a boy sweeping the step with his head down. Light: warm light from the upper left. Expression: a quick, charming half-smile with a sly sideways glance, the face of a girl who has already sold you something. A faint ember tint.

people.imagined: Ducking his head at a doorway he does not need to duck under, a frown carved between his brows, not going out to watch the levy ride past.
people.subject: The moment: ducking his head under a doorway lintel that he clears easily, a frown set. Face: a heavy, closed, brown face; a deep vertical frown line carved between the brows, the plainest thing on it; dark eyes lowered; a broad nose; a hard, downturned mouth. Hair: black, cropped close, with a little grey at the temples. Body: tall and heavy, hunched, the shoulders bunched and the neck stretched forward under the lintel, the stance slow. Clothing: a fine plain brown robe, clean, under a leather apron with burn marks, the sleeves rolled above hairy forearms; thick-soled, dusty boots. Hands and objects: the right hand on the doorframe, a scar across its back. Background: the doorway of a reeling shed with steam and heat at his back, rows of copper basins and girls bent over them in blur; outside in the road a line of mounted riders in red passes, small and indistinct, with a banner bearing no marks; he is turned away from them. Light: dim, heavy light from the upper left, a gleam of steam behind. Expression: a deep vertical frown cut between the brows, the eyes lowered and the hard mouth shut, the look of a man refusing something without a word. A faint ember tint.

people.imagined: Beside racks of red cocoons warmed by a vent stone, her hands warm even in winter, grinning, sneaking a visit.
people.subject: The moment: standing beside racks of red cocoons, hands held out warm. Face: a round, rosy, bright face; bold dark eyes; thick brows; a wide grin showing a gap between the front teeth; freckles across the nose. Hair: brown, in one thick braid tied with a red ribbon. Body: sturdy, feet planted and chest out, the face lifted proudly, the tray balanced at waist height; the broad hands are plain. Clothing: a clean fine red-brown apron dress with a wide pocket stuffed with silk thread and a belt of knotted red cord; sleeves rolled up; her braid thick with a red ribbon. Hands and objects: both hands hold a tray of red cocoons, her forearms rosy. Background: racks of wooden trays rising behind her in shelves, each packed with fat red cocoons like small red lanterns, a flat grey stone glowing orange-red in a niche to warm them, a stack of mulberry leaves in a basket, and a thin warm haze above everything. Light: orange glow from the niche on her right cheek, warm key light from the upper left. Expression: a wide, bold, cheerful grin with bright, unabashed eyes, proud of the tray and of herself. A faint ember tint.

people.imagined: Winded from a flight of steps, holding up his first unbroken thread in both careful hands, pale and proud.
people.subject: The moment: holding up a single unbroken thread in both hands, pale and breathless. Face: a thin, pale, serious young face; wide earnest eyes; thin brows pulled together; a small nose; a small proud mouth pressed tight. Hair: black and soft, damp at the forehead from the climb. Body: thin and narrow, shoulders heaving slightly from the climb, one hand pressed to his ribs, his frame lost in a jacket too big at the shoulders, the sleeves bunched at the wrists. Clothing: a clean red-brown jacket with a high collar and cords tied at the wrists. Hands and objects: a fine white thread held between two small wooden pegs; his fingers are clean, long and trembling a little. Background: behind him a steep flight of narrow stone steps climbing to a shed door with steam leaking out, a row of copper basins visible within, a woman's hand, his mother's, reaching toward his shoulder from the edge of the frame, and a bright morning sky over the roof. Light: warm morning light from the upper left. Expression: a breathless, proud, careful look with wide earnest eyes and two spots of pink on the pale cheeks, afraid to breathe on the thread. A faint ember tint.
